messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Hi Todd. Your Magic M. 40T order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It ships November 30.

Your Miner D. and Power K. are already set aside for you at our Tennessee warehouse. They'll go out in the same box as the 40T to (address hidden).

The 40T is the part still on its way to our warehouse. You can follow that shipment at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status. We'll email you tracking as soon as your order ships.
I was part of Batch 1

That's right, Todd. Your order is Batch 1, which is why it came with the free Miner D. and Power K..

Batch 1 orders go out first. Your date is still November 30, though. All the 40T units were built and left the factory together, so being in Batch 1 puts you at the front of the line within that date. It doesn't make the date earlier.

Your Duster and Power K. are already at our Tennessee warehouse, and they'll ship in the same box as your 40T. We'll email you tracking as soon as it ships.
What happened to Nov 12

Fair question, Todd. November 12 was when Magic M. planned to send the units out of their factory to us, not when your miner would ship to you. Our November 8 email said some units were already packed and with the freight forwarder, with the rest leaving the factory on the 12th.

After that they travel to our warehouse, get checked in, and then ship to you. That's why your order shows November 30.

You've been waiting since August 1, and I'm sorry it's taken this long. You can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.
That shipment status page doesn’t show anything.
Let me check the page myself.
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sorry, Todd, that one's on me. I can't see the page from my side, so I can't say why your 40T isn't showing there. Don't rely on it for this order.

Your order still ships November 30, with the Duster and Power K. in the same box. Updates on the 40T come to your email, like the November 8 one with the factory photos. We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships.
I just received my Hammer Thor P2 and received no emails on that item.
Used the store-orders skill

Glad it landed, Todd. It was delivered to you on November 14.

You're right about the emails. We wrote to you on November 11 when we set up the replacement and said tracking would follow. I can't find any shipping email on that order after that, so it looks like you never got one. I'm sorry about that.

For your records, the tracking was (number hidden): (tracking link hidden)

Is the Thor P2 up and hashing okay?
Yes, but wasn’t it suppose to come with the extra fan and mean well power supply.
Used the store-orders skill
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Handed to the team · missing parts on a replacement unit, and a dispute hit on the account, so a pers

You're right, Todd. That ad says the Thor P2 ships with a power supply, a power cord and a spare fan. I've passed your order to the team so they can check what should have been in your box. Someone will pick it up and get back to you with an answer by email.

To help them, can you tell me exactly what was in the box? Did any power supply come with it, or just the miner? A quick photo of everything you received would be ideal.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, Todd, that helps. So you did get a power supply, a GM-H250S12 (12V, 25A), not a Mean Well. The ad only says "power supply", without naming a brand. On paper that unit has plenty of headroom for the Thor P2's roughly 166W.

The spare fan is the open question. Can you confirm there was no second fan in the box, and that the power cord was there? The team will see your photo with this chat when they pick up your ticket.
2 power cords, plastic power supply, 1 fan and miner

Got it, Todd. So the box had the miner, its fan, the power supply and two cords, and the spare fan is the one thing missing. That matches what I've already passed to the team. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email about the fan.

Your miner has everything it needs to run in the meantime. Anything else I can help with today?
Nope that’s it, thank you
Used the chat-interview skill

You're welcome, Todd. Watch your email for the team's answer on the fan, and for your 40T tracking.

Before you go, one quick thing: what made you expect a Mean Well power supply with the Thor P2? Was it something you saw on our site, or is that just what you're used to running?
Have a great day
You too, Todd. Enjoy the Thor P2.
In the picture it shows a mean well with options to connect more than one miner not a closed plastic power supply

Fair point, Todd. The ad photo shows an open-frame silver supply with screw terminals, the kind you can run more than one miner from. What you got is an enclosed unit, so it isn't what the picture shows.

The team already has the power supply on your ticket along with the missing fan, and your photo shows which one came. I can't promise what they'll do about it, but someone will look at both and get back to you by email.
Ok, thank you, you guys have been awesome with me so far
That's good to hear, Todd, thank you. Enjoy the Thor P2. The team will email you about the fan and the power supply, and we'll send tracking for your 40T as soon as it ships.
